headline: China's ruling Communist Party and cabinet have told officials to keep high-tech investment from turning into a bubble while keeping AI safe and controllable.
score_reason: Official national policy document on AI and investment; sets direction rather than concrete penalties.
importance_line: What changed: Beijing is telling local officials and companies that the AI push must not turn into wasteful overbuilding, which affects Chinese officials, investors and AI firms, though the guidelines set direction and do not yet show how accountability will be enforced.
summary: Reuters reports that new guidelines issued on Friday by China's ruling Communist Party and cabinet, as cited by state news agency Xinhua, call for breakthroughs in AI theory, more computing power and national pilot bases for industrial AI, but also tell officials to avoid blind investment and "swarm-like" rushes into high-tech sectors. Officials whose blind investment causes major losses will be held to account, and the guidelines ask for monitoring and emergency-response systems to keep AI "safe, reliable and controllable".
